title: The Hymn of the Robe of Glory
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: G. R. S. Mead presents the Hymn of the Robe of Glory, also known as the Hymn of the Pearl. Its symbolic journey of exile, forgetting and return offers a distinctive image of the soul's recovery of its spiritual inheritance.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/MeadGRSEchoesFromTheGnosisVolXTheHymnOfTheRobeOfGlory1908).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
